architectural_defect_fixed.lossy_path_before: build_census() folded every ExtractionBatch's typed SemanticObservation records (SemanticObservation::Symbol/Type/FunctionIdentity/FunctionSignature, each a full SemanticRecordHeader<Subject> with record_id/dimension/status/subject/scope/repository/revision/extractor/evidence_refs/provenance) directly into a lossy generic SemanticFact{subject,predicate,object} triple via semantic_observation_fact()/function_signature_summary(), then discarded the original typed record. function_signature_summary() never even included generics/abi/visibility/is_extern in its display string. No mechanism retained ExtractionDiagnostic objects -- only bare diagnostic-id strings survived via ObligationResult.diagnostics: Vec<String>, so a caller could not distinguish which DiagnosticCode (e.g. ParseFailure vs InvalidInput) caused a given UNKNOWN obligation once outside the transient ExtractionBatch.
architectural_defect_fixed.typed_path_after: CensusReport and NormalizationReport each gained three fields: typed_semantic_records: Vec<SemanticObservation>, evidence: Vec<Evidence>, diagnostics: Vec<ExtractionDiagnostic>. build_census() now folds every batch's observations/evidence/diagnostics into these fields first (deduped by record_id/id, deterministically sorted), and only THEN derives the compatibility SemanticFact projection by iterating the already-retained typed_semantic_records -- never independently from the raw batches -- so `facts` is provably downstream of, not a second independently-mutable copy of, the typed truth. normalize() carries all three fields through an N0 pass (normalize_typed_records/normalize_evidence/normalize_diagnostics: deterministic id-ordering plus exact-id dedup only, zero field mutation or restructuring) alongside the pre-existing string-canonicalizing logic for `facts`. CensusExtractionAccounting gained a diagnostics: BTreeMap<String, ExtractionDiagnostic> + diagnostic(&self, id) lookup so an obligation's diagnostic id resolves back to its real DiagnosticCode.
architectural_defect_fixed.layering_change: DiagnosticCode/ExtractionDiagnostic moved from adapter/src/semantic/extractor.rs into core/src/semantic/diagnostic.rs (pure typed data, no adapter mechanics), re-exported from adapter for zero-ripple compatibility -- this was required so CensusReport (a core type) could hold ExtractionDiagnostic without introducing a core -> adapter dependency. ObligationResult was deliberately left in adapter; its per-artifact/extractor attribution role is already served by the runtime-level CensusExtractionAccounting, avoiding two independently-mutable structures for the same obligation-ledger concept.

code_review_findings.discrepancy_found_and_fixed: CensusReport's doc comment claimed typed_semantic_records is de-duplicated by id where a record legitimately repeats across batches (matching evidence/diagnostics, which dedup via BTreeMap), but the implementation at the checked commit only sorted the Vec -- no dedup_by call existed, so an exact record_id repeat across batches would have survived as a literal duplicate entry, contradicting the doc comment. This was a real doc/implementation gap, not exercised by any test at that commit. Fixed in the immediately following commit (fa529fb051): dedup_by(record_id) added after the sort in both build_census and normalize_typed_records, plus a new regression test (typed_semantic_records_collapse_an_exact_record_id_repeat_across_batches) proving two batches reporting the identical observation collapse to one entry through census and normalization. Re-verified after the fix in the primary pass above: 107/107 passing, clippy/fmt clean.

runtime_invariants_established: Every SemanticObservation a SemanticExtractor produces is retained, with full structural fidelity (all FunctionSignature/TypeIdentity/SymbolIdentity/FunctionIdentity fields, identity, scope, repository, revision, extractor id+version, evidence refs, provenance), in CensusReport.typed_semantic_records and NormalizationReport.typed_semantic_records -- never collapsed into a display string before those fields are populated.

Every Evidence and ExtractionDiagnostic a batch reports is retained in CensusReport.evidence/diagnostics and NormalizationReport.evidence/diagnostics, deduplicated by id and deterministically ordered, so an observation's evidence_refs and an obligation's diagnostic id remain resolvable to full objects after build_census/normalize -- including distinguishing a parse failure from a read failure that both report EpistemicStatus::Unknown.

The bootstrap SemanticFact envelope (`facts`) is now provably a derived compatibility projection of typed_semantic_records, constructed by iterating that already-retained collection, never independently from raw batches -- removing `facts` entirely would lose only display convenience, never semantic content, for any fact with a richer typed kernel record.

typed_semantic_records/evidence/diagnostics de-duplicate by id/record_id consistently across all three fields, matching their doc contracts and preventing literal duplicate entries when the same record legitimately repeats across batches.

No compiler-resolved canonical type identity is ever fabricated: TypeIdentity.canonical stays None for source-level-only spelling, verified both by a dedicated round-trip test and by the independent pass's repository-wide grep for `canonical: Some` finding only the pre-existing unrelated test fixture.

acceptance_statement: Atlas Studio now preserves the currently-real Rust semantic records losslessly through Census and typed normalization; the generic SemanticFact envelope is only a compatibility projection and is no longer the authoritative semantic carrier.
